_comment: THE LIVE WIRE. The only definition of what a RUNNING session's `live` block and the opt in `live_names` block may carry.
Named by privacy/upload-contract.json (v4 fields `live` and `live_names`); scripts/gen_live.py emits server/builder/live_spec.py
(Pydantic, extra forbid at every level) and mobile/src/generated/live.ts. Never hand edit the output.
What is here: enums, integers, clocks, and 16 hex salted file ids (HMAC of the path relative to the checkout, under a salt that never
leaves the machine or the server's privacy_prefs row). What is NOT here, and cannot be added without editing this file: a path, a
file or directory name (except inside LiveNames, the third opt in exception), a command, a prompt, a tool name, a sentence.
Every sentence about a live session is rendered by the reader from these ids and numbers (analysis.live.sentence on the server,
src/live/sentence.ts on the phone), so rewording one is a client change, never a re upload.
Python is the reference. Every enum below copies a table in analysis/live.py or analysis/plain.py, and server/tests/test_contract.py
pins each copy to its table both ways; the three Live Activity enums copy mobile/modules/builder-live/src/BuilderLive.types.ts and
are pinned to it the same way. A refusal is an enum code plus the numbers it rests on, never prose.
Measured beside the caps: 400 map rows is 2.8x the largest number of distinct tool paths in one transcript of the corpus (141, of
57 root transcripts, 2026-09-13), UNMEASURED JUDGEMENT CALL beyond that; 600 frames is analysis.live.MAX_FRAMES; 4 decisions is
analysis.live.MAX_DECISIONS; 120 characters for a basename is the contract's own cap.

LiveActivity.name: kind
LiveActivity.doc: what the agent is doing at computed_at (analysis.live.ACTIVITY_KINDS)

LiveActivity.name: role
LiveActivity.doc: the role of the file the activity is about, by path shape only (plain.role_of); unknown when it names none

LiveActivity.name: attempt
LiveActivity.doc: editing only: writes to one file since it was last read or tested; 0 otherwise

LiveActivity.name: since_s
LiveActivity.doc: seconds the current activity had run at computed_at; the reader adds the seconds since computed_at, for display only

LiveActivity.name: files
LiveActivity.doc: distinct files in the current run of this activity

LiveActivity.name: calls
LiveActivity.doc: tool calls in the current run of this activity

LiveActivity.name: file_id
LiveActivity.doc: the last call's file, as a salted id; null when it named none

LiveEvidence.name: window_calls
LiveEvidence.doc: tool calls in the window the verdict read

LiveEvidence.name: errors_before
LiveEvidence.doc: failing results in the window before it

LiveEvidence.name: new_files
LiveEvidence.doc: files entering the window that nothing earlier in the segment touched

LiveEvidence.name: checkpoints
LiveEvidence.doc: writes, test runs and commits in the window

LiveEvidence.name: repeats
LiveEvidence.doc: copies of the most repeated comparable call in the window

LiveEvidence.name: churn_writes
LiveEvidence.doc: writes to the most rewritten file in the window

LiveEvidence.name: fail_run
LiveEvidence.doc: the longest run of failing results in a row in the window

LiveEvidence.name: blind_edits
LiveEvidence.doc: files modified in the window that nothing in the session read or wrote first

LiveEvidence.name: stuck_s
LiveEvidence.doc: seconds since the circling run began; 0 unless circling

LiveEvidence.name: files_changed
LiveEvidence.doc: files the segment changed, less the calls an error answered

LiveEvidence.name: commits
LiveEvidence.doc: commit calls in the segment no error answered

LiveEvidence.name: background
LiveEvidence.doc: background tasks the session started that had not reported back when the turn ended; 0 while it runs

LiveVerdict.name: state
LiveVerdict.doc: converging, circling or lost, or where the turn stands; null when no rule fired (reason says which refusal)

LiveVerdict.name: basis
LiveVerdict.doc: the rule that fired; null exactly when state is

LiveVerdict.name: reason
LiveVerdict.doc: why there is no verdict; null exactly when state is set

LiveVerdict.name: file_id
LiveVerdict.doc: the churned file when the basis is causes:file_churn_with_failures

LiveVerdict.name: evidence
LiveVerdict.doc: every count the rules read, always all present

LiveEta.name: elapsed_s
LiveEta.doc: attended plus autonomous seconds so far; null when the producer could not supply them

LiveEta.name: typical_s
LiveEta.doc: the median active seconds of similar finished sessions that ran at least this long

LiveEta.name: n
LiveEta.doc: the sessions the refusal or the quartiles rest on; null when nothing was counted (the repository is unresolved)

LiveEta.name: needed
LiveEta.doc: analysis.live.ETA_MIN_SESSIONS, the sessions a quartile needs

LiveEta.name: unattended
LiveEta.doc: the similar set is unattended runs, not sittings with you there

LiveEta.name: reason
LiveEta.doc: why there is no ETA; the numbers above are null when this is set, except n

LiveDecision.name: kind
LiveDecision.doc: a hard to undo thing the agent did (analysis.live.DECISION_KINDS), first occurrence per kind

LiveDecision.name: ts
LiveDecision.doc: Unix seconds of the first occurrence

LiveDecision.name: event_n
LiveDecision.doc: its position among the session's events

LiveDecision.name: count
LiveDecision.doc: occurrences of this kind in the session

LiveNeedsYou.name: score
LiveNeedsYou.doc: 0-100: how much this session needs you now; mission control sorts by it

LiveFile.name: id
LiveFile.doc: salted id of the path relative to the checkout

LiveFile.name: dir_id
LiveFile.doc: salted id of its directory; null at the base

LiveFile.name: depth
LiveFile.doc: directories between the base and the file; null outside the base

LiveFile.name: last_read_ts
LiveFile.doc: Unix seconds; null when never read

LiveFile.name: last_edit_ts
LiveFile.doc: Unix seconds; null when never edited

LiveMap.name: files
LiveMap.doc: the rows touched most recently; the slim body keeps only the rows activity and verdict name

LiveMap.name: files_total
LiveMap.doc: every file the session touched, so a cut map says how much it cut

LiveFrame.name: t
LiveFrame.doc: seconds from the session's first event

LiveSample.name: tokens
LiveSample.doc: every token the session's turns moved; null when the transcript records no usage, never 0

LiveName.name: name
LiveName.doc: the file's basename and nothing else: no directory, never a separator

LiveNames.name: files
LiveNames.doc: one basename per map row, keyed by its id

fields.name: live_version
fields.doc: the version of this spec that produced the document

fields.name: computed_at
fields.doc: when this state was computed; the reader ages since_s and anchors the ETA on it

fields.name: activity
fields.doc: null before the session's first event

fields.name: decisions
fields.doc: one per kind, hardest to undo first

fields.name: map
fields.doc: the files the session touched, as salted ids

fields.name: timelapse
fields.doc: reads, edits and failures over time; null in the slim body the live list serves
